name: FA_MASS_ADDITIONS_
description:
FA_MASS_ADDITIONS stores information about assets that you want to automatically add to Oracle Assets from another system. You can use this table to load assets for system conversions.
When you run the mass additions create process, Oracle Assets inserts one row into this table for each invoice line it selects from Oracle Payables.
When you run the Mass Additions Post process, Oracle Assets creates assets or adjustments from any rows in which the POSTING_STATUS is POST. Mass additions post inserts rows into FA_ADDITIONS, FA_ASSET_HISTORY, FA_ASSET_INVOICES, FA_BOOKS, FA_DISTRIBUTION_HISTORY, FA_TRANSACTION_HEADERS, FA_INVOICE_TRANSACTIONS, FA_DEPRN_SUMMARY, FA_DEPRN_DETAIL, and FA_TRANSFER_DETAILS. Oracle Assets then changes POSTING_STATUS and QUEUE_NAME to POSTED.
POSTING_STATUS shows the status of a mass addition. POSTING_STATUS and QUEUE_NAME are the same, except when you assign user-defined queue names, or you split or merge a mass addition. The following table summarizes the relationship between POSTING_STATUS and QUEUE_NAME:
POSTING_STATUS
QUEUE_NAME -- Description
=========================
NEW
NEW -- Status when mass addition is first created.
ON HOLD
ON HOLD -- Waiting for additional information before posting.
Posting Status after split
SPLIT -- You divided a multi-unit mass addition into individual mass additions.
Posting Status after merge
MERGED -- You merged other mass additions into this one.
POST
ADD TO ASSET -- You are adding a mass addition to an existing asset as a cost adjustment and the mass addition is ready for posting.
POST
POST -- Ready for posting.
POSTED
POSTED -- The Mass Additions Post program created an asset from this mass addition.
DELETE
DELETE -- Delete this mass addition.
The SPLIT_MERGED_CODE column tells you whether a mass addition was split or merged:
MC
Merged child - You merged this mass addition into another one.
MP
Merged parent - You merged other mass additions into this one.
SC
Split child - Oracle Assets created this mass addition from a multi-unit mass addition.
SP
Split parent - You split this multi-unit mass addition into single-unit mass addition.
When you add the cost of a mass addition to an existing asset, NEW_MASTER_FLAG is set to Yes by the Prepare Mass Additions form when the resulting asset has the asset category and description of the mass addition. This value is No when the resulting asset has the asset category and description of the existing asset.
Descriptive flexfield segments (attribute1-30 and global_attribute1-20) will map to the same columns in FA_ADDITIONS if populated. This rule applies only to merged invoice parents, split invoices, or individual invoice lines which become new assets. This rule does not apply to Add-to-Assets invoice lines.
For more information on loading this table, read the About the Mass Additions Interface section in the Asset Setup chapter in the Oracle Assets User Guide.
When you add a mass addition to an existing asset, Oracle Assets does not allow you to enter a salvage value for the mass addition. 
 Scope: public
 Product: FA
 Lifecycle: active
 Display Name: FA Mass Additions
 Category: BUSINESS_ENTITY FA_ASSET
 @rep:ihelp fa/@p_ma_oi#p_ma_oi About the Mass Additions Interface, Oracle Assets Help

columns.name: FIXED_ASSETS_COST
columns.description: Asset cost. Required field. Do not use thousands separator. Use a period or comma as decimal separator.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the mass addition. Valid values: ON HOLD, NEW, POST, MERGED. ON HOLD means the asset is not ready for addition. NEW means the asset must be added. POST means the asset is posted. MERGED means the asset is merged.

columns.name: QUEUE_NAME
columns.description: Mass addition queue name. Valid values: ON HOLD, NEW, POST, MERGED. ON HOLD means the asset is not ready for addition. NEW means the asset must be added. POST means the asset is posted. MERGED means the asset is merged.

GROUP means the asset is a collection of member assets. EXPENSED means assets do not depreciate and have to be expensed in the period of addition.

columns.description: Asset is added in a short fiscal year indicator. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.description: Date short fiscal year asset added to acquiring company. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be within current calendar period of the primary company.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DEPRN_START_DATE
columns.description: Date short fiscal year asset began depreciating in the acquired company's books. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be within current calendar period of the primary company.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Identification number of the group asset.

columns.description: Total units to adjust. Use a whole number with no thousands separators.

columns.description: Date to start amortizing the net book value for an asset if the transaction is amortized. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be equal to or later than the date the asset was placed in service.

columns.name: PROPERTY_1245_1250_CODE
columns.description: Property type. Valid values: 1245, 1250. 1245 means personal. 1250 means real.

columns.description: Indicates whether the asset is in use. Possible values: Y, N.

columns.name: OWNED_LEASED

columns.name: NEW_USED

columns.description: Salvage type. Valid values: PCT, AMT, SUM. PCT means percentage of value. AMT means amount. SUM means sum of member assets.

columns.name: PERCENT_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value as a percentage of asset cost. Must be a value from 0 to 100.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Depreciation limit type. Valid values: PCT, AMT, SUM, NONE. PCT means percentage of asset cost. AMT means the limit is an amount. SUM is used for group assets, means the sum of member assets. NONE means there is no depreciation limit.

columns.name: REDUCTION_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation reduction rate for the group and its assets. Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: REDUCE_ADDITION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether reduction rate is applied to additions. Applicable only to group assets. Used when depreciable basis rule has year end balance with positive reduction amount and half year rule. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: REDUCE_ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether reduction rate is applied to adjustments. Applicable only to group assets. Used when depreciable basis rule has year end balance with positive reduction amount and half year rule. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: REDUCE_RETIREMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether reduction rate is applied to retirements. Applicable only to group assets. Used when depreciable basis rule has year end balance with positive reduction amount and half year rule. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: RECOGNIZE_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Recognize gain or loss at asset retirement. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: RECAPTURE_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Reserve can exceed recoverable asset cost. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: LIMIT_PROCEEDS_FLAG
columns.description: Limit asset proceeds to recoverable cost. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: TERMINAL_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Indicates whether terminal gain or loss must be recognized for member asset retirement. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: TRACKING_METHOD
columns.description: Group asset tracking method for calculating group and member asset depreciation. Valid values: ALLOCATE, CALCULATE. ALLOCATE means allocate group depreciation amount to member assets. CALCULATE means calculate depreciation for each member asset.

columns.name: EXCESS_ALLOCATION_OPTION
columns.description: Indicate whether excess depreciation for group asset is allocated to member assets. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: DEPRECIATION_OPTION
columns.description: Depreciate member asset based on either group or individual member asset depreciation rules. Valid values: GROUP, MEMBER.

columns.name: MEMBER_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether group asset depreciation is sum of member asset depreciation or calculated separately.Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: ALLOCATE_TO_FULLY_RSV_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether to allocate group asset depreciation amount to a reserved member asset.Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: OVER_DEPRECIATE_OPTION
columns.description: Over depreciation is allowed for group assets. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: NBV_AT_SWITCH
columns.description: Net book value at switch.

columns.name: PERIOD_FULL_RESERVE
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: PERIOD_EXTD_DEPRN
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: PRIOR_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT

columns.name: PRIOR_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Depreciation limit as a percentage of asset cost immediately prior to beginning extended depreciation.

columns.name: PRIOR_METHOD_ID

columns.name: PRIOR_FLAT_RATE_ID

columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Investment Tax Credfit amount identification number for the asset.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Lease identifier for capital or operating lease.

columns.name: LESSOR_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Lessor identifier.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense due to revaluation. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. Reporting purposes only.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_CAPACITY
columns.description: Production capacity. Enter a whole number with no thousands separators.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_BASIS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Revaluation reserve for calculating amortization of revaluation reserve. Updated when asset is revalued or has amortized adjustment.

columns.name: REVAL_CEILING
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Upper limit for revaluating asset cost.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Change in net book value due to revaluation of depreciation reserve for revaluation period. For all other periods, the revaluation reserve amount after depreciation run.

columns.name: UNREVALUED_COST
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Cost that is independent of any revaluations.

columns.name: FULLY_RSVD_REVALS_COUNTER

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_FLAG

columns.name: ERROR_MSG

columns.name: LOW_VALUE_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this line is a low value asset.

columns.name: CREATE_EXPENSED_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source lines need to be created as an expensed asset.

columns.name: CAP_THRESHOLD_CHECK_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this line was evaluated against the capitalization thresholds.

columns.name: INVOICE_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of invoice line. It is based on INVOICE LINE TYPE lookup codes like FREIGHT,TAX,ITEM etc.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Type of invoice distribution. It is based on INVOICE DISTRIBUTION TYPE lookup codes like ITEM,ERV, FREIGHT, TAX, etc.

columns.name: INVOICE_LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the invoice line.

columns.name: PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: The organization that is responsible for the project work.

columns.name: TASK_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: The task organization that is responsible for the work task. This is a task-specific attribute.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: The expenditure expendature organization that is responsible for the work task. This is a task-specific attribute.

columns.name: PROJECT_TXN_DOC_ENTRY_ID
columns.description: Identifies a project document entry.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The project expenditure classification type.

columns.name: INTANGIBLE_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset is an intangible asset.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease payment schedule identification number.

columns.name: ASSET_SCHEDULE_NUM
columns.description: Unique Identifier of an asset lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Supplier name for associated asset invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_VOUCHER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Voucher number for associated asset invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Payment number for associated asset invoice.

columns.name: PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Number of the project from which the costs are collected, summarized, and transferred.

columns.name: PROJECT_TASK_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. User-defined number of the task from which costs are collected, summarized, and transferred. Only populated if the costs are summarized by task.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Controls the speed of depreciation of an asset by multiplying this factor by the annual depreciation rate.

columns.name: FULLY_RESERVE_ON_ADD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to fully depreciate an asset when the asset is added.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation amortization.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_AMORTIZATION
columns.description: Year-to-date revaluation reserve amortization amount.

columns.name: REVALUED_COST
columns.description: Increase or decrease in cost due to revaluation of the asset.  Can be a positive or negative amount.

columns.name: BACKLOG_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Life-to-date backlog depreciation amount.

columns.name: YTD_BACKLOG_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date backlog depreciation amount.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUST_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Customer location identifier indicating where the supplier shipped the goods.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Internal location identifier indicating where the supplier shipped the goods.

columns.name: IB_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: The reference identifier used to link a fixed asset with an installed base asset.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: User-defined name for a batch of records in the interface table. Free text field.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the asset transaction approval.

columns.name: APPROVAL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the transaction should be approved separately or as part of a mass transaction group.

columns.name: AUTO_POST_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an asset transaction should be automatically posted after approval.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Annual interest rate used to calculate annual interest expense.

columns.name: YTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Year-to-date annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: LTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Total annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: PURCHASING_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Item category unique identifier.

columns.name: APPROVAL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction approval cycle.

columns.name: MERGED_COST
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. The sum of the fixed asset costs of the parent mass addition line and its child lines.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
